# m.options.contracts

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Reference data on options contracts: type, exercise style, expiration, and strike.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.options.contracts(symbols=None, *, underlying=None, contract_type=None, as_of=None, expired=False, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

- [Methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `Symbol`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows its rule under [shared arguments](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | Option contracts to describe; leave it out to list contracts. `dm.ALL` is refused; leave `symbols` out instead. |
| `underlying` | Only contracts of this underlying's exact Massive ticker, such as `"AAPL"` or `"I:SPX"`. A table of them in a `Symbol` column is read value by value. A live table is followed. In a static table, one failed value fails the call. |
| `contract_type` | `dm.ContractType.CALL` or `PUT`; leave it out for both. |
| [`as_of`](README.md#as_of) | The day whose contracts to list; leave it out for today. |
| `expired` | True lists only expired contracts; False, the default, those still trading. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | `"ticker"`, `"underlying_ticker"`, `"expiration_date"`, or `"strike_price"`. |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows in total without `symbols`. With them, it counts per contract, so it has no effect. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Further endpoint parameters, such as `{"strike_price_gte": 100}`. Keys: `expiration_date`, `expiration_date_gt`, `expiration_date_gte`, `expiration_date_lt`, `expiration_date_lte`, `strike_price`, `strike_price_gt`, `strike_price_gte`, `strike_price_lt`, `strike_price_lte`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | All Contracts (REST) | Contract Overview (REST) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Options Basic | Updated daily, 2 years | Updated daily, 2 years |
| Options Starter | Updated daily, All history | Updated daily, All history |
| Options Developer | Updated daily, All history | Updated daily, All history |
| Options Advanced | Updated daily, All history | Updated daily, All history |
| Options Business | Updated daily, All history | Updated daily, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The row's instrument, as Massive's ticker. From REST `ticker`: "The ticker for the option contract." |
| `OptionRoot` | String | The OCC option root, read from `Symbol`: the symbol without its `O:` prefix and its last 15 characters (expiry, type, and strike), such as `SPXW` for `O:SPXW251219C06000000`. It is never mapped to the underlying: an adjusted contract keeps its own root, such as `AAPL1`. |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose symbol the library can't read. That row's `Symbol` is null. Null on every other row. When `MassiveConfig.unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, such a row fails the table instead, and the column is absent. |
| `AdditionalUnderlyings` | String | If an option contract has additional underlyings or deliverables associated with it, they will appear here. See here (https://www.optionseducation.org/referencelibrary/faq/splits-mergers-spinoffs-bankruptcies) for some examples of what might cause a contract to have additional underlyings. The column holds Massive's value as JSON text. |
| `Cfi` | String | The 6 letter CFI code of the contract (defined in ISO 10962 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_10962)) |
| `ContractType` | String | The type of contract. Can be "put", "call", or in some rare cases, "other". |
| `Correction` | long | The correction number for this option contract. |
| `ExerciseStyle` | String | The exercise style of this contract. See this link (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Option_style) for more details on exercise styles. |
| `ExpirationDate` | String | The contract's expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format. |
| `PrimaryExchange` | String | The MIC code of the primary exchange that this contract is listed on. |
| `SharesPerContract` | double | The number of shares per contract for this contract. |
| `StrikePrice` | double | The strike price of the option contract. |
| `Underlying` | String | The instrument Massive lists the row under, as Massive's ticker. From REST `underlying_ticker`: "The underlying ticker that the option contract relates to." |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
